description: The data of a deleted Slack message.

workspace.description: The name of the workspace in the connection.

team_id.description: The Slack team id of the workspace.

team_name.description: The name of the Slack team.

channel_id.description: The Slack id of the channel, the direct message, or the group.

ts.description: The Slack ts of the message. The message id is <team>/<channel>/<ts>.

event.description: The Slack event as Slack sends it.

previous_text.description: The text of the deleted message, when Slack sends it.
